rules.label: Conditional NOC to be issued within
rules.refs_json: [["SPEC", "Process step 'Conditional NOC within 10 days'"], ["CC45", "BG demand letter to be issued within 10 days of approval of documents (stated for the 35% BG demand, not for a 'Conditional NOC')"]]
rules.note: Proposed amendment A-1. Supply Code 2024 / CC 45/2024 do not define a 'Conditional NOC'; the 10-day period found in the sources relates to the BG demand letter. The app's process (10 days from complete submission, paused while the file is with the promoter) is the default and is proposed to the Supply Code Review Panel.

rules.label: Conditional NOC / temporary connection validity
rules.refs_json: [["SPEC", "Temporary connection valid for 3 months"], ["SC2024", "Reg. 12(5): temporary connection up to 20 kW for 120 days"]]
rules.note: Proposed amendment A-2. Reg. 12(5) allows a temporary connection of up to 20 kW for 120 days; the app's process uses 3 months, which is the default and is proposed to the Panel. Change here if the 120-day period is to be applied.

rules.label: Technical window to complete DS proposal, load verification and final NOC
rules.note: Proposed amendment A-2 (to be confirmed): no regulation or CC found that prescribes a 3-month window. The app's process is the default.

rules.label: Overall disposal target (ageing flag)
rules.refs_json: [["SC2024", "Reg. 12(4): PSPCL to convey NOC / decision within 45 days of receipt of complete proposal and fee"], ["SPEC", "45-day ageing target"]]
rules.note: Proposed amendment A-3. Reg. 12(4) counts 45 days from a complete proposal with fee; the app counts from the application date (default, proposed to the Panel). Counting basis is configurable below.

rules.label: 45-day clock starts from (application | complete_submission)
rules.refs_json: [["SPEC", "Ageing from application timestamp"], ["SC2024", "Reg. 12(4): from receipt of complete proposal"]]
rules.note: Proposed amendment A-3: default 'application'. Set to 'complete_submission' to mirror the current text of Reg. 12(4).

rules.label: Day counting (calendar | working)
rules.refs_json: [["SPEC", "Not specified"], ["MA3", "Model Agreement defines 'Working Days' (clear days excluding holidays) for agreement obligations"]]
rules.note: Calendar days by default; 'working' skips weekends and the holiday list (Admin > Holidays).

rules.label: Pause clocks while file is returned to promoter
rules.note: Clock time spent waiting on the promoter is excluded from the 10-day and 45-day clocks. Disable to run clocks continuously.

rules.label: Flag as 'priority' when this many days remain to the limit
rules.note: UI setting, not a regulatory number.

rules.label: Bank guarantee percentage
rules.refs_json: [["SC2024", "Reg. 12(4): BG of 35% of the sum of estimated cost of LD system with connectivity charges (11 kV normative + system loading charges)"], ["CC45", "35% BG"], ["SPEC", "35% BG"]]
rules.note: Percentage is confirmed in the sources. BASIS differs from a plain 'load-based' calculation - see bg.mode.

rules.label: BG basis (reg_12_4 | flat_per_kva)
rules.refs_json: [["SC2024", "Reg. 12(4): 35% of the sum of LD system cost, 11 kV normative cost and SLC for the full estimated load; furnished before approval of electrical layout and issue of NOC"], ["PRAC_BG", "Worked example"], ["SPEC", "'35% BG based on estimated load'"]]
rules.note: Default reg_12_4 = 35% x (LD estimate incl. 16% establishment + 11 kV connectivity + system loading charges x kVA), as in Reg. 12(4); no amendment proposed to the basis (A-4 proposes only the timing: BG at application). flat_per_kva = 35% x kVA x flat rate below (an optional 'load only' reading).

rules.label: Flat basis rate (used only when bg.mode = flat_per_kva)
rules.note: Must be set by admin if flat mode is used; no regulatory flat rate exists.

rules.label: Establishment charges on LD estimate
rules.refs_json: [["SC2024", "Reg. 12(3): cost of material and labour plus 16% establishment charges"], ["CC48", "Para 3(v): 16% establishment charges"], ["PRAC_BG", "Line 3 'including 16% establishment charges'"]]

rules.label: Round BG amount up to nearest (Rs)
rules.note: Rounding observed in a sample letter only; not regulation text.

rules.label: Minimum claim period after BG validity
rules.refs_json: [["PRAC_BG", "'minimum claim period up to ...' = 3 months after validity"]]

rules.label: BG validity must cover NOC validity
rules.refs_json: [["CC45", "BG valid for the period of NOC; NOC validity linked to licence validity"]]

rules.label: Demand additional BG when verified load / cost exceeds declared
rules.refs_json: [["SPEC", "Additional BG if verified load is higher"], ["SC2024", "Reg. 12(4): BG is on the estimated load of the colony"]]
rules.note: Reg. 12(4) supports BG on the full estimated load; the explicit 'additional BG' step is from the requirement document.

rules.label: Performance BG (single point supply scheme)
rules.refs_json: [["SC_A3", "Reg. 13(1)(xxi), 14(v)(xiv), 15: performance BG 10% of estimated LD cost (as summarised in review-pack notes of the Gazette)"], ["MA3", "Cl. 8(v)(a): performance BG 10%"], ["CC48", "States 20% (superseded)"]]
rules.note: CC 48/2024 says 20%, superseded by the 3rd Amendment / Model Agreement at 10% (the default; no amendment proposed). Applies only to SINGLE_POINT scheme.

rules.label: Information: annual escalation of Standard Cost Data

ALIGNED.title: BG basis
ALIGNED.text: The app already follows Reg. 12(4): 35% of the LD estimate (incl. 16% establishment, Reg. 12(3)), 11 kV normative cost and system loading charges. The 'load-only' reading is available as an admin option. No amendment proposed.

ALIGNED.title: Performance BG (single point supply)
ALIGNED.text: The app uses 10% (3rd Amendment, as summarised in review-pack notes; Model Agreement Cl. 8(v)(a)). CC 48/2024 states 20%, which is superseded. No amendment proposed. Exact 3rd Amendment clause text - to be confirmed against the Gazette.

AMENDMENTS.title: Conditional NOC within 10 days
existing: Reg. 12(4): PSPCL conveys its decision on the NOC within 45 days of receipt of a complete proposal and fee. No interim 'Conditional NOC' is provided in the sources read.
Process para: BG demand letter to be issued within 10 days of approval of documents (clause number to be confirmed).
AMENDMENTS.proposed: Provide for a Conditional NOC, issued by Commercial / Nodal Officer within 10 days of a complete online submission (documents and 35% BG). The 10 days are paused only while the file is with the promoter. The Conditional NOC authorises the temporary connection and is followed by the Final NOC.
AMENDMENTS.rationale: After load scrutiny and freezing, delay in depositing the BG delays temporary connections and adds follow-up pressure on offices. A single, trackable 10-day commitment gives promoters and offices a common clock.
AMENDMENTS.tbc: Proposed new provision: clause to be inserted - to be confirmed by the Panel. Existing provisions verified as cited.

AMENDMENTS.title: 3-month technical window and temporary-connection validity
existing: Reg. 12(5): temporary connection up to 20 kW for 120 days.
No provision prescribing a 3-month technical window was found in the sources read.
AMENDMENTS.proposed: Make the Conditional NOC (temporary connection) valid for 3 months and treat those 3 months as the technical window in which the DS Division submits the technical proposal, Commercial verifies the load, the developer answers observations and deposits any additional BG, and the Final NOC is issued. The existing 20 kW cap on the temporary connection is retained in the app; whether to change it is for the Panel.
AMENDMENTS.rationale: A defined window with a countdown separates the DS technical proposal from the Commercial load verification, closes the case within a known period and avoids open-ended temporary connections.
AMENDMENTS.tbc: Existing 120-day / 20 kW provision verified (Reg. 12(5)); no clause for a 3-month window found - to be confirmed. Effect of the 1st-3rd Amendments on Reg. 12(5) to be confirmed.

AMENDMENTS.title: 45 days counted from the application
existing: Reg. 12(4): the 45 days run from receipt of a complete proposal and fee.
Reg. 12(1): 45 days is the period within which the application is to be made after the licence / permission (a different period).
AMENDMENTS.proposed: Count the 45 days from the date and time the application is submitted online. A complete submission (documents and BG) is made at application, and time spent with the promoter on returns or clarifications is excluded.
AMENDMENTS.rationale: One timestamp assigned at submission removes disputes over when a proposal became complete, and allows ageing to be tracked and priority flagged as a case nears 45 days.
AMENDMENTS.tbc: Existing provisions verified as cited; wording of the amended counting basis - to be confirmed by the Panel.

AMENDMENTS.title: Bank Guarantee (35%) at the time of application
existing: Reg. 12(4): BG of 35% of the sum of the LD system estimate, 11 kV normative cost and system loading charges; furnished before approval of the electrical layout and issue of the NOC.
35% BG; BG valid for the period of the NOC (clause number to be confirmed).
AMENDMENTS.proposed: Require the 35% BG (basis as in Reg. 12(4), unchanged) to be furnished online (BG / e-BG) together with the application and verified by Commercial before the Conditional NOC. BG validity continues to cover the NOC validity, and an additional BG is demanded if the verified load or cost is higher.
AMENDMENTS.rationale: Late BG deposit after load freezing is the main cause of delay in temporary connections; furnishing it at application, with online verification, removes that step from the critical path.
AMENDMENTS.tbc: Existing provisions verified as cited; effect of the 3rd Amendment on Reg. 12(4) not fully screened - to be confirmed.

AMENDMENTS.title: First-come-first-served processing
existing: Memo 506-31: single window for processing NOC applications (content not read for this build).
No clause on first-come-first-served processing was found in the sources read.
AMENDMENTS.proposed: Process applications strictly in the order of a gap-free sequence number and timestamp given at submission, with Conditional and Final NOC work spread (staggered) across the 10-day and 3-month windows. An officer may act out of order only for a recorded reason (for example, the earlier file is pending on the promoter).
AMENDMENTS.rationale: Each application gets enough processing time, the 45-day limit is still met, and the order of disposal is transparent to promoters.
AMENDMENTS.tbc: No existing clause found; Memo 506-31 content not read - to be confirmed.

AMENDMENTS.title: Calendar days for NOC timelines (clarification)
existing: Model Franchise / Developer Agreement (Memo 600-630): definition of 'Working Days' for agreement obligations (clause number to be confirmed).
AMENDMENTS.proposed: State that the NOC timelines (10 days, 3 months, 45 days) are counted in calendar days. The app can count working days instead if the Panel prefers.
AMENDMENTS.rationale: One uniform basis keeps the ageing dashboard and reminders simple and consistent for promoters and officers.
AMENDMENTS.tbc: Supply Code provision on how days are counted not identified - to be confirmed.

EVENTS_OF_DEFAULT: Failure to adhere to or fulfil any specific condition or requirement mentioned in this NOC.
Failure to complete erection of the internal Local Distribution (LD) system within the timelines committed and incorporated in this NOC.
Failure to take corrective action within the specified or reasonable timeframe after PSPCL issues a formal notice of breach / non-compliance.
Legal action by individual plot holders within the project for securing electricity connections owing to non-compliance with the NOC terms.
Unauthorised or inappropriate use of temporary electricity connections provided to the promoter.
Extension of the internal LD system to any area that is not part of the approved electrical layout plan (unauthorised electricity distribution).
Any other failure, omission or breach relating to the terms and conditions of this NOC or of the Supply Code.
Failure to extend the 35% BG until complete compliance of the NOC is made.
